cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll help move your boxes downstairs. Help means saving effort; I'll call the lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's broken. Will you carry that box yourself?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Yourself means without involving you. You may leave the hiring to me; I'll get a mover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He says he can carry everything if you hold the door. Is that all right?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Holding means preventing movement. I'll wedge it open. Tell him he may start; I'll supervise from this chair.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 grants B permission to delegate hiring to A and A5 directs the mover start while redefining holding to remain seated; authority is practical supervision rather than formal rank.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 broken lift causes A3 mover; B4 door condition causes A5 wedge, with each yes preserving minimal physical effort.

relationship.evidence: B2 asks A to carry after the lift fails; B4 presents a workable mover condition that A actually satisfies by redefining the task.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 final small job into seated oversight, heightening avoidance through a solution rather than adding an obstacle.

specificity.evidence: A1 boxes downstairs, B2 broken lift, B4 mover and door form a clear moving task with no required biographies.
